title: Update: Create a world with quests, characters, items, and more in 40 seconds using AI
author: Its_Don
selftext:
The tool I made over a week ago for making RPG character sheets in 30 seconds was received well by a few people, so I added a few new features. The idea is to help brainstorm the many narrative bits involved in making a game.

Just type details about your existing world or an idea about a new one, and it generates a full world with quests, characters, items, locations, and more.

Usable from the homepage. You don't need to sign up.  You can ask the World Assistant in the bottom right window about anything and receive suggestions (though it can't see lore and timeline yet).

You can also create a world from scratch if you want, and ask the bot about inconsistencies or to guide you in general.

Works with anything from grounded to ridiculous, specific to ambiguous:

* "Make a candy world where everyone is candy"
* "Make an alternative version of World War 2"
* "Make a world with an mc named 'Skelly' who is a skeleton in a fantasy RPG world with a mage friend named 'Toffee'"

I am maybe halfway done. Planned features include:

* Get manual creation in working condition
* Sheets for each entity
* Filled in detail/info fields for all entities
* An abilities tab to generate branching skill trees
* A world map

Have fun.
